title: Rabbids Invasion
description:
S1 E46 — Holy Rabbid-Cow!
In the country, a fly fascinates two Rabbids; after unintentionally crushing it in an empty can, they decide to go and catch some of the ones flying around a cow.

title: Rabbids Invasion
description:
S1 E49 — Hypno Rabbid
The Chief Rabbid invents new tasks for the Rabbids; finding a disk with a spiral on it, he makes his troops fan him by making it spin, but ends up hypnotized; the other Rabbids take advantage of this and reverse roles.

title: Talking Tom and Friends
description:
S1 E44 — Funny Robot Galileo
Worried his act will flop at the CEO's birthday party later, Ben invents a comedy robot; but the laughter soon stops when the robot decides to bring down Tom and Ben Enterprises.

title: Talking Tom and Friends
description:
S1 E46 — Poker Face
When Talking Tom loses a bet, The Landlord becomes the new CEO of Tom and Ben Enterprises and turns it into a cleaning company; Talking Ginger decides he's the only one who can make it right.

title: Angry Birds
description:
S1 — Chucked Out; Bomb's Awake
Red and his fearless bird friends must find a way to protect their precious eggs from the Bad Piggies and their relentless assault.

title: Angry Birds
description:
S2 — Hide and Seek; Sink or Swim
Chuck is a hide-and-seek champion, but sometimes his hiding spots can be a bit too good; Red can't play in the water because he can't swim.

title: The Legend of Zelda
description:
S1 E9 — Stinging a Stinger
Link interrupts a highway bandit mugging a peddler named Sleazenose on the path, and to express his gratitude, he gives a jeweled sword to Link and takes his old sword off his hands.

title: The Legend of Zelda
description:

Since there's little activity from Ganon's minions, the Princess assigns chores to Link.

title: The Legend of Zelda
description:

After the king decides to build a water park, so his subjects can cool off in summer heat, water monsters attack the construction crew.

Ganon comes up with a new wand to counter Link and Zelda's magical weapons' power over his monsters.

title: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe
description:
S2 E10 — Web of Evil
Hoping to acquire Eternia, Webstor unleashes an arachnid catastrophe that hinders He-Man and the heroic warriors' joy of victory over the Snake Men in the Mystic Mountains.

title: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe
description:
S2 E11 — The Rattle of the Snake
He-Man and the Masters track King Hiss through Subternia to a long-lost snake temple, which holds the key to releasing a terrible power.

title: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe
description:

He-Man tries to stop King Hiss from reaching the Well of Darkness, unaware that Evil-Lyn is planning something catastrophic.

title: Pac-Man and the Ghostly Adventures
description:

Betrayus tries to learn the secret location of the Repository, so he possesses his mother's body while Dr. Buttocks hypnotizes the President.

title: Pac-Man and the Ghostly Adventures
description:

A super gigantic robot invades Pacopolis wielding a weapon that renders the power berries powerless.

title: Atomic Betty
description:

Betty scours the galaxy to find Sparky and X-5 after they go missing.

In space, Betty arrives on her ship to discover that Sparky has dismantled it and X-5 for annual tune-ups; on Earth, Betty and her friends run a long-distance course for gym class when Betty is called for a mission.
